node.title: Petal squarefree classification counting soundness
node.statement: If the squarefree realizable locator points in each residue-line kernel decompose into finitely many charged classes and uncharged classes each bounded by a polynomial with exponent independent of c, then petal_kernel_realizable_sparsity holds.
node.attack_surface: finite-union counting rule for classified squarefree kernel points
node.falsifier: a finite classification with each uncharged class uniformly polynomial but whose union grows beyond the same uniform-polynomial regime
